name: 26206-chatprefill-qwen36moe35bfp8-1gpu
model: Qwen/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-FP8. Ungated, ~37.5 GB of FP8 weights on one 80 GB card.
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3, one node, no router and no external cache tier.
parallelism: tp1. No tensor, pipeline, data or expert parallelism.
architecture: Qwen3_5MoeForConditionalGeneration (`model_type: qwen3_5_moe`), a hybrid linear-attention MoE behind a vision shell; served text only, the vision tower is loaded and never entered. Layer, head, expert and vocab dimensions are in the checkpoint's own config.json.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=80, warmup the first 10%, bounded at 800 requests with a 1200 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, one turn, no shared prefix: 1000 prompt tokens and 1000 output tokens, both FIXED (stdev 0, min = max). Greedy (temperature 0.0) with `ignore_eos`, so the output length is exactly 1000 rather than approximately. Seed 42.
purpose: A chat assistant on a 35-billion-parameter mixture-of-experts model, serving 80 concurrent users thousand-token prompts and replies on one GPU.
launch:
# Flat `key: value` only -- a nested block is DROPPED by the flat parser and the engine then runs
# without something this file declares.

model-path: Qwen/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-FP8
tp-size: 1
disable-radix-cache: true

# Leave `max-running-requests` UNSET. Set explicitly, the engine sizes the recurrent-state pool
# from it instead of from its own memory split, and the pool becomes an admission gate.
